device_scope: Meizu Note 16 / Android 15; one previously paired test phone
actor: Muse's actual cloud environment, verified CLI.8 and original private connection

steps: Search Xiaohongshu for a public hiking article without logging in
Read two routes and their visible source
Create a new note with the routes and source
Save, leave the note, reopen and verify the title and body
Return HOME and confirm media volume zero

failure_and_recovery.agent_intervention: Muse initially stopped and requested human recovery. A maintainer supplied read-only reconnection evidence and instructed bounded status checks followed by fresh observation; Muse then completed the task.
failure_and_recovery.claim_limit: Phone reconnection was autonomous. Agent task continuation required a maintainer follow-up; this is not an unattended end-to-end recovery pass.
failure_and_recovery.other_events: A coordinate tap did not dismiss a login prompt; a fresh semantic node action recovered. A note-app network notice was dismissed without changing network settings.

later_readiness_check.claim_limit: A later bounded check did not restore connectivity. The phone was also absent from the maintainer's USB and mDNS lists; the cause is undiagnosed. The earlier successful task is not proof of sustained background availability.

evidence.result_review: Actual write/reopen trees have equal nonempty title and body; phone footage independently shows the note, list, same reopened note and HOME.
evidence.phone_recording: Four silent original segments, fully decoded and hash-verified; segmented capture is not a seamless real-time recording.
evidence.muse_continuous_recording: not captured; only phone footage was retained

not_verified: Muse successfully recovering an interrupted task using the revised recovery guide without maintainer assistance
Controlled long-idle or multi-day background endurance
Independent first-time user installation and pairing
Other phone models or device platforms
publication_boundary: This reviewed summary excludes credentials, device and connection identifiers, private paths, screen text and raw screenshots. It does not replace earlier evidence or broaden its scope.
